node.statement: Closing inequality: because b in C and 1-sigma_g>0, (1-sigma_g)*dist_1(q,C) <= (1-sigma_g)*||q-b||_1 = ||(1-sigma_g)*(q-b)||_1. Using the identity in 1.4.3.5.2 and the triangle inequality gives at most sum_{j in B} a_j^+||p_j-b_j||_1 + sum_{j in N} a_j^-||b-p_j||_1. Nodes 1.4.3.3 and 1.4.3.4 bound these two sums by (sigma-sigma_g)*tau/4 and nu_v*(2+4*delta), respectively; adding them proves (1-sigma_g)*dist_1(q,C) <= (sigma-sigma_g)*tau/4 + nu_v*(2+4*delta).
